# Shipwright Studio

> Shipwright Studio is an independent engineering studio crafting websites, web apps, and AI infrastructure for startups and small teams. Based in the San Francisco Bay Area, working worldwide. Founded and run by a senior software engineer.

## Services

- **Custom website development**: Fast, accessible, search-friendly marketing sites and landing pages. Modern stack, no bloated templates.
- **Web application development**: Interactive dashboards, internal tools, and customer-facing apps — designed, engineered, and deployed end to end.
- **AI infrastructure**: LLM application engineering, inference cost optimization, GPU communication and distributed training performance.

## Selected work

- **Lumen** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lumen/): An interactive photography lab that teaches the exposure triangle (aperture, shutter speed, ISO) with real-time canvas simulations of depth of field, motion blur, noise, and light metering.
- **Forge** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/forge/): An LLM inference cost estimator. Enter model size, quantization, GPU type, batch size, and traffic to estimate GPU count, latency, and monthly serving cost.
- **The Lab** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/ideas/): An open bank of 122 web experiments — games, developer tools, browser extension prototypes, and small apps. Two new experiments are designed, built, and shipped every day. Recent additions: **Quick Notes** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/quick-notes/), a free online popup-notes demo — create, colour-label, pin and search notes that persist in localStorage, with copy-all and .txt export, all in the browser, **Currency Convert** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/currency-convert/), a free online currency converter — convert between 12 major currencies with clearly-labelled sample rates, quick-amount chips, swap, reverse conversion and a clickable rates table, all computed locally, **Focus Blocker** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/focus-blocker/), a free online focus timer and distraction-blocker concept — build a blocklist of distracting sites, run 25/50/90-minute focus sessions with a live countdown, and try a simulated blocked-site demo with session stats, all in the browser, **BMI Check** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/bmi-calc/), a free online BMI calculator — enter height and weight in metric or imperial units for an instant BMI with WHO category, a visual gauge and healthy weight range, with honest context on what BMI can and can't tell you, all computed locally, **Dice Lab** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/dice-stats/), a free online dice roller and probability explorer — build any pool from d4 to d100 with modifiers and presets like 4d6 drop lowest or advantage, roll with animated dice, and compare the exact theoretical distribution against your observed results on a live histogram, all in the browser, **Coin Flip** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/coin-flip/), a free online coin flip tool — a brass 3D coin spins and lands on a face decided by crypto.getRandomValues before the animation ends, with Call it mode, best-of 3/5/7 series, streaks and running stats, all in the browser, **Orb Eater** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/orb-eater/), a free online agar-style arena game — eat pellets and smaller rivals to grow, dodge bigger ones, with three difficulty levels and a local best score, all in the browser, **robots.txt Builder** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/robots-builder/), a free online robots.txt builder — click together crawler rules, with preset templates, live file preview and validation, then copy or download the finished file, all computed locally, **Band Name Gen** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/band-names/), a free online band name generator — one click for a name with genre filters, style modes, favourites and a daily name, all in the browser, **Markdown Clipper** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/markdown-clipper/), a free online HTML-to-Markdown converter — paste HTML to get clean Markdown with live preview, copy and .md download, all computed locally, **Mini Tower Defense** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/tower-defense/), a free online tower defense game — place arrow, cannon and frost towers along a serpentine path, survive 20 escalating waves, upgrade and sell towers, with wave previews and local best-wave tracking, all in the browser, **Barcode Gen** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/barcode-generator/), a free online Code 128 barcode generator — type any text to render a crisp barcode with checksum, human-readable text toggle, size and colour controls, and PNG/SVG download, all computed locally,
